Bus numbers change on reboot; NVIDIA connectors have no i2c link: dev.py finds the bus whose EDID (0x50) carries the unit serial and refuses to flash a bus that doesn't. relay = mains outlet (scripts/power_cycle.py). test=false: Dan's working screens; dev.py refuses them unless --force.
